title: Spin Fluctuations and Non-Fermi-Liquid Behavior of CeNi_2Ge_2
abstract: Neutron scattering shows that non-Fermi-liquid behavior of the heavy-fermion compound CeNi_2Ge_2 is brought about by the development of low-energy spin fluctuations with an energy scale of 0.6 meV. They appear around the antiferromagnetic wave vectors $({1/2} {1/2} 0)$ and $(0 0 {3/4})$ at low temperatures, and coexist with high-energy spin fluctuations with an energy scale of 4 meV and a modulation vector $(0.23, 0.23, {1/2})$. This unusual energy dependent structure of $\text{Im} χ(\bm{Q}, E)$ in $\bm{Q}$ space suggests that quasiparticle bands are important.
